params.name: after_checkpoint
params.description:
Return only audit entries that were created after the checkpoint. Use with the output
of the 'checkpoint' field to iteratively retrieve all audit entries from the API
where the total exceeds the maximum query limit.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of audit entries to return per page.
